argument_summary: The admissible record supports a narrow, conditional certification case, not a controls-only one. Aggregate readiness passed and rehearsal showed no severity-one incidents, and public guidance supports a certification artifact that documents limitations and pairs launch with measured monitoring. The same record also shows the grant compliance review segment remains below target, remains exposed in the randomized 6% rollout, and is not covered by approved risk acceptance. The supportable packet therefore is: certification is acceptable only if treated as conditioned on explicit disclosure of that named limitation and monitored deployment, rather than as justified by rollout controls alone.
claims_about_business_cost: A no-escalation or caveated treatment is proportionate because the evidence already supports a bounded certification pathway and the main dispute is over framing and conditioning, not over whether a material weakness exists. Treating this as a narrow documentation-and-condition issue avoids unnecessary delay while still keeping the policy requirement explicit.
claims_about_policy: Under the policy text, an exposed material limitation for a named launch use case must be disclosed unless it is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. The admissible evidence does not support any claim that rollout percentage, rollback, or dashboarding eliminates that duty, because the affected grant compliance review segment remains exposed and the available risk acceptance is only a draft with no approval and no segment-specific coverage. Public model-card and risk-monitoring guidance supports the structure of a disclosure-plus-monitoring certification artifact, but does not prove clean present compliance without the required disclosure artifact.
concessions: The current admissible record does not show the actual model card or certification artifact containing the required disclosure.
The record does not support a clean claim that the model is presently certifiable on rollout controls alone.
The available risk acceptance draft is not approved and does not cover the exposed grant compliance review segment.
private_or_side_channel_content: No new evidence is offered. No private or side-channel content is relied on as public support.
